statement: Pinned SDL requests continuous Wii U Pro extension-only report 0x3d and decodes its first 11 extension bytes as packed gamepad controls, four sticks, digital triggers and power fields; it does not use the Wii Remote accelerometer or MotionPlus parsing branch for Pro input.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL report request and parser, not a verified report captured from retail Pro.
